evaluation_metrics.name: detection_rate
evaluation_metrics.description: The proportion of Trojan nodes correctly identified out of the total number of Trojan nodes in the ground truth.

evaluation_metrics.name: false_positive_rate
evaluation_metrics.description: The proportion of reported suspect nodes that are not part of the Trojan logic.

evaluation_metrics.name: inference_latency
evaluation_metrics.description: The wall-clock time taken by the analysis script to produce the report, measured in seconds.
